title: ICPC 2025 South Regionals Gold - 1st Place @ UH Site
content: Secured a gold medal at ICPC 2025 South Regionals by placing first at the UH site. Always proud to represent my university and deliver strong performances at ICPC. Check out the [ICPC 2025 South Regionals](https://icpc.global/regionals/finder/SCUSA-2026/standings) for more details. Our team name was **CoogLimitExceeded**.
